events.title: Build with AI 3.0 – GDG Brisbane
events.description: GDG Brisbane hosts an evening for developers and data engineers to explore practical Generative AI and Data Engineering, with talks on LLM evaluation and a workshop on serverless agents. It attracts intellectually engaged people interested in technology and systems thinking, offering both high-level strategy and hands-on learning.

events.title: Anywhere Festival 2026
events.datetime: Fri 1 May – Sun 31 May (ongoing this week)
events.description: This unique festival transforms unconventional spaces across Brisbane into stages for nearly 300 performances, offering immersive and experimental theatre, dance, and music. It's designed to be exploratory and community-driven, attracting creative and adventurous audiences.

events.title: Make A Scene
events.description: A free exhibition showcasing 90s Australian queer culture, fashion, and community, featuring self-expressions of LGBTQIA+ identity and Brisbane-based labels. It's an immersive and community-focused dive into recent history and subculture.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.description: An immersive, multi-sensory exhibition by Icelandic-Danish artist Olafur Eliasson, featuring installations that explore light, water, and air temperature, and including a perpetually rebuilding Lego city. It offers a thought-provoking and creative experience.

events.title: Redlands Coast AdventureFest
events.description: A 10-day festival offering a wide range of outdoor and adventure activities like kayaking, hiking, and nature tours across the Redlands Coast. It's ideal for adventurous, nature-oriented individuals seeking social and active experiences.

events.title: Weaving is Healing Workshop
events.description: A hands-on craft workshop to weave a basketling using the Figure 8 coil technique, conducted in a ceremony-style sharing and healing circle in a natural setting. It appeals to those interested in creative, hands-on activities, community ritual, and grounded wellness.

events.title: Brisbane Boardgamers – Saturday Night
events.description: A long-running community group for boardgame enthusiasts, offering an evening of games, conversation, and connection. It naturally attracts curious, analytical, and game-loving people of all ages in a low-cost, social setting.

events.title: Brisbane Language Exchange – Friday
events.description: A recurring weekly event for practicing languages and meeting internationally-minded people, fostering cultural exchange and natural conversation. It's ideal for curious, open-minded individuals looking to connect.

events.title: Data Science & Analytics Meetup – Brisbane Friday
events.description: A recurring gathering for data, analytics, and tech-curious people to connect, discuss ideas, and share insights. It's a conversational and intellectually stimulating meetup for professionals and enthusiasts, fostering community around shared interests.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival 2026
events.datetime: Fri 24 Apr – Sun 25 May (ongoing this week)
events.location: Brisbane Powerhouse, The Tivoli, Princess Theatre, Fortitude Music Hall
events.description: The festival offers a diverse line-up of stand-up comedy, featuring established acts like Claire Hooper and Pete Helliar, performing at multiple venues across Brisbane. It's known for attracting a varied audience interested in live performance.

events.title: Circa – Swan Lake
events.description: Circa presents an acrobatic and theatrical reinterpretation of Swan Lake, blending circus arts with live music for a visually stunning and inventive performance. It's a world-class production from a renowned Brisbane company.

events.title: The Yellow Diary – Live in Brisbane
events.description: Acclaimed Indian indie-pop/alternative band The Yellow Diary performs live, known for their introspective lyrics and layered sound, followed by a Bollywood Club Night. This is an intimate gig with strong artistic value, appealing to fans of world music and unique live experiences.

events.title: Endless Swarm – Body Hammering Australia Tour
events.description: Scottish powerviolence band Endless Swarm delivers a ferocious live performance of blast-driven hardcore at an authentic indie/punk venue. This is an underground, high-energy gig with strong atmosphere for fans of raw music subcultures.

events.title: Brisbane Riverside Social Walk
events.location: Brisbane Riverside (meeting point posted on Meetup)
events.description: A recurring, low-key social evening walk along the Brisbane River, hosted by a community group. It's perfect for meeting active and curious people in a relaxed outdoor setting where conversation flows naturally.

events.title: Polestar 5 Design & Tech Preview
events.datetime: Tue 12 May – Sat 16 May, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM daily
events.location: Polestar Brisbane, 773 Ann Street, Fortitude Valley
events.description: An open house event at Polestar Brisbane offering a preview of the Polestar 5, with daily talks on its design, performance, and sustainability, along with food and drinks. It’s a free, low-key opportunity for design and tech enthusiasts interested in sustainable transport and EV engineering.

events.title: The Drover's Wife – The Opera (World Premiere)
events.description: The world premiere of an opera based on Henry Lawson's iconic Australian story, offering a unique opportunity to experience a new major work of musical theatre. It presents a strong artistic and cultural experience.

events.title: The Sapphires
events.datetime: Tue 28 Apr – Sun 24 May (ongoing this week)
events.description: The beloved musical story of four Aboriginal women singing soul music during the Vietnam War, offering a joyful, moving, and musically rich theatrical experience. It's a significant cultural and artistic event.

events.title: Precious
events.description: A free exhibition at the Museum of Brisbane displaying over 3,000 items from various personal collections, offering a glimpse into rare, beautiful, and intriguing objects normally hidden in homes. It’s a curious and community-driven showcase of human collecting habits.

events.title: Brisbane Social Sport Group – Wednesday Social
events.description: A recurring social sport meetup for a friendly, mixed crowd, designed for getting active and naturally meeting new people. It fosters community and provides a relaxed environment for interaction.

events.title: Dog Lovers Festival Brisbane 2026
events.datetime: Sat 16 May – Sun 17 May, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM daily
events.description: Queensland's largest celebration of dogs, offering opportunities to meet hundreds of breeds, shop dog brands, and explore adoption zones. It's a genuinely community-spirited outdoor event fostering natural conversation among animal lovers.
